scripts.prepare-assets: npm run grain && npm run audio
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render Pulse out/pulse-1080p30.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render PulseVertical out/pulse-vertical-1080x1920.mp4
scripts.render:4k60: cross-env PULSE_FPS=60 npm run prepare-assets && cross-env PULSE_FPS=60 remotion render Pulse out/pulse-4k60.mp4 --scale=2
